notes.title: Beat me at my own game!
notes.notes:
Saturday, June 23rd at 12:00 Noon (CDT) to 1:00 P.M.

I will be giving away copies of Luminous Combat to any player that can beat me at my own game. Just open up the game and press "Play Now". If you beat me in a match then I will send you a code for a free copy of the game to give to whomever you want!

notes.title: Appearance Update Live!
notes.notes:
The major kinks have been worked out and the appearance update is now live. Players now have some choice on how they look! 

Additionally, Deathmatch has been replaced with Score mode. Players noted that there was little difference in feel between Survivor and Deathmatch and no mode other than Darkernaut in which players got points for taking blocks and kills.
